name: bunmail
description: Self-hosted email API for developers: free alternative to SendGrid/Resend

scripts.dev: bun run build:css && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.test:all: bun test test/unit test/e2e && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:unit:coverage && bun run test:e2e:coverage && bun run coverage:check
scripts.coverage:check: awk -F'[:,]' -v minL=0.64 -v minF=0.73 'FNR == 1 { tiers++ } /^SF:/ { f = substr($0, 4); recs[FILENAME]++ } /^DA:/ { k = f SUBSEP $2; L[k] = 1; if ($3 + 0 > 0) H[k] = 1 } /^FNF:/ { if (!(f in FF) || $2 + 0 > FF[f]) FF[f] = $2 + 0 } /^FNH:/ { if (!(f in FH) || $2 + 0 > FH[f]) FH[f] = $2 + 0 } END { if (tiers < 2 || recs["coverage/unit/lcov.info"] == 0 || recs["coverage/e2e/lcov.info"] == 0) { print "coverage:check: missing or empty LCOV for a tier (need coverage/unit and coverage/e2e)"; exit 1 } for (k in L) lf++; for (k in H) lh++; for (x in FF) ff += FF[x]; for (x in FH) fh += FH[x]; l = lh / lf; fn = fh / ff; printf "Coverage (unit + e2e merged, line-weighted): lines %.2f%% (floor %.0f%%), functions %.2f%% (floor %.0f%%)\n", 100 * l, 100 * minL, 100 * fn, 100 * minF; if (l < minL || fn < minF) { print "coverage:check: below the floor"; exit 1 } }' coverage/unit/lcov.info coverage/e2e/lcov.info
scripts.xss:toolchain: D=node_modules/.cache/xss-toolchain; test -x $D/node_modules/.bin/xss-scan || (mkdir -p $D && printf '%s' '{"name":"xss-toolchain","private":true}' > $D/package.json && bun add --cwd $D typescript@5.9.3 @kitajs/html@4.2.13 @kitajs/ts-html-plugin@4.1.4)
